17: pub enum MappingTarget<'a> {
18:     /// For mapping a path to a specific syntax.
19:     MapTo(&'a str),
20: 
21:     /// For mapping a path (typically an extension-less file name) to an unknown
22:     /// syntax. This typically means later using the contents of the first line
23:     /// of the file to determine what syntax to use.
24:     MapToUnknown,
25: 
26:     /// For mapping a file extension (e.g. `*.conf`) to an unknown syntax. This
27:     /// typically means later using the contents of the first line of the file
28:     /// to determine what syntax to use. However, if a syntax handles a file
29:     /// name that happens to have the given file extension (e.g. `resolv.conf`),
30:     /// then that association will have higher precedence, and the mapping will
31:     /// be ignored.
32:     MapExtensionToUnknown,
33: }

35: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
36: pub struct SyntaxMapping<'a> {
37:     mappings: Vec<(GlobMatcher, MappingTarget<'a>)>,
38:     pub(crate) ignored_suffixes: IgnoredSuffixes<'a>,
39: }

217:     pub fn insert(&mut self, from: &str, to: MappingTarget<'a>) -> Result<()> {
218:         let glob = GlobBuilder::new(from)
219:             .case_insensitive(false)
220:             .literal_separator(true)
221:             .build()?;
222:         self.mappings.push((glob.compile_matcher(), to));
223:         Ok(())
224:     }

226:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax<'b>(
227:         &self,
228:         assets: &'b HighlightingAssets,
229:         config: &Config<'_>,
230:         input: &mut OpenedInput<'_>,
231:     ) -> Result<SyntaxReferenceInSet<'b>> {
232:         if let Some(language) = config.language {
233:             let syntax_set = assets
234:                 .syntax_set_cell
235:                 .get_or_try_init(|| assets.serialized_syntax_set.deserialize())?;
236:             return syntax_set
237:                 .find_syntax_by_token(language)
238:                 .map(|syntax| SyntaxReferenceInSet { syntax, syntax_set })
239:                 .ok_or_else(|| Error::UnknownSyntax(language.to_owned()));
240:         }
241: 
242:         let path = input.metadata.user_provided_name.as_ref().or(match &input.kind {
243:             OpenedInputKind::OrdinaryFile(path) => Some(path),
244:             _ => None,
245:         });
246: 
247:         let path_syntax = if let Some(path) = path {
248:             let abs_path =
249:                 PathAbs::new(path).map_or_else(|_| path.to_owned(), |p| p.as_path().to_path_buf());
250:             let path = abs_path.as_path();
251:             let path_label = path.to_string_lossy();
252:             let undetected = if input.description.name == path_label {
253:                 input.description.name.clone()
254:             } else {
255:                 path_label.into_owned()
256:             };
257: 
258:             let candidate = Candidate::new(path);
259:             let candidate_filename = path.file_name().map(Candidate::new);
260:             let mut syntax_match = None;
261:             for (ref glob, ref syntax) in self.mappings.iter().rev() {
262:                 if glob.is_match_candidate(&candidate)
263:                     || candidate_filename
264:                         .as_ref()
265:                         .map_or(false, |filename| glob.is_match_candidate(filename))
266:                 {
267:                     syntax_match = Some(*syntax);
268:                     break;
269:                 }
270:             }
271:             if syntax_match.is_none() {
272:                 if let Some(file_name) = path.file_name() {
273:                     syntax_match = self
274:                         .ignored_suffixes
275:                         .try_with_stripped_suffix(file_name, |stripped_file_name| {
276:                             Ok(self.get_syntax_for(stripped_file_name))
277:                         })
278:                         .ok()
279:                         .flatten();
280:                 }
281:             }
282: 
283:             if let Some(MappingTarget::MapToUnknown) = syntax_match {
284:                 Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax(undetected))
285:             } else if let Some(MappingTarget::MapTo(syntax_name)) = syntax_match {
286:                 assets
287:                     .find_syntax_by_name(syntax_name)?
288:                     .ok_or_else(|| Error::UnknownSyntax(syntax_name.to_owned()))
289:             } else {
290:                 let file_name = path.file_name().unwrap_or_default();
291:                 match (
292:                     assets.get_syntax_for_file_name(file_name, &self.ignored_suffixes)?,
293:                     syntax_match,
294:                 ) {
295:                     (Some(syntax), _) => Ok(syntax),
296:                     (_, Some(MappingTarget::MapExtensionToUnknown)) => {
297:                         Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax(undetected))
298:                     }
299:                     _ => assets
300:                         .get_syntax_for_file_extension(file_name, &self.ignored_suffixes)?
301:                         .ok_or_else(|| Error::UndetectedSyntax(undetected)),
302:                 }
303:             }
304:         } else {
305:             Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax("[unknown]".into()))
306:         };
307: 
308:         match path_syntax {
309:             Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax(path)) => {
310:                 let reader = &input.reader;
311:                 let consider_first_line = reader.content_type.map_or(true, |content_type| {
312:                     !content_type.is_binary() || config.show_nonprintable
313:                 });
314:                 let from_first_line = if consider_first_line {
315:                     let syntax_set = assets
316:                         .syntax_set_cell
317:                         .get_or_try_init(|| assets.serialized_syntax_set.deserialize())?;
318:                     String::from_utf8(reader.first_line.clone())
319:                         .ok()
320:                         .and_then(|line| syntax_set.find_syntax_by_first_line(&line))
321:                         .map(|syntax| SyntaxReferenceInSet { syntax, syntax_set })
322:                 } else {
323:                     None
324:                 };
325:                 from_first_line.ok_or(Error::UndetectedSyntax(path))
326:             }
327:             other => other,
328:         }
329:     }

331:     pub fn mappings(&self) -> &[(GlobMatcher, MappingTarget<'a>)] {
332:         &self.mappings
333:     }
334: 
335:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax_for(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<MappingTarget<'a>> {
336:         // Try matching on the file name as-is.
337:         let candidate = Candidate::new(&path);
338:         let candidate_filename = path.as_ref().file_name().map(Candidate::new);
339:         for (ref glob, ref syntax) in self.mappings.iter().rev() {
340:             if glob.is_match_candidate(&candidate)
341:                 || candidate_filename
342:                     .as_ref()
343:                     .map_or(false, |filename| glob.is_match_candidate(filename))
344:             {
345:                 return Some(*syntax);
346:             }
347:         }
348:         // Try matching on the file name after removing an ignored suffix.
349:         let file_name = path.as_ref().file_name()?;
350:         self.ignored_suffixes
351:             .try_with_stripped_suffix(file_name, |stripped_file_name| {
352:                 Ok(self.get_syntax_for(stripped_file_name))
353:             })
354:             .ok()?
355:     }
356: 
357:     pub fn insert_ignored_suffix(&mut self, suffix: &'a str) {
358:         self.ignored_suffixes.add_suffix(suffix);
359:     }
360: }

383:     }

389:         assert_eq!(

391:             Some(MappingTarget::MapTo("Bourne Again Shell (bash)"))
392:         );
393:         map.insert("/etc/profile", MappingTarget::MapTo("My Syntax"))
394:             .ok();
395:         assert_eq!(
396:             map.get_syntax_for("/etc/profile"),
397:             Some(MappingTarget::MapTo("My Syntax"))
398:         );
399:     }

403:         let map = SyntaxMapping::builtin();
404: 
405:         assert_eq!(
406:             map.get_syntax_for("/path/to/build"),
407:             Some(MappingTarget::MapToUnknown)
408:         );
409:     }

412:     /// verifies that SyntaxMapping::builtin() doesn't repeat `Glob`-based keys
413:     fn no_duplicate_builtin_keys() {
414:         let mappings = SyntaxMapping::builtin().mappings;
415:         for i in 0..mappings.len() {
416:             let tail = mappings[i + 1..].into_iter();
417:             let (dupl, _): (Vec<_>, Vec<_>) =
418:                 tail.partition(|item| item.0.glob() == mappings[i].0.glob());
419: 
420:             // emit repeats on failure
421:             assert_eq!(
422:                 dupl.len(),
423:                 0,
424:                 "Glob pattern `{}` mapped to multiple: {:?}",
425:                 mappings[i].0.glob().glob(),
426:                 {
427:                     let (_, mut dupl_targets): (Vec<GlobMatcher>, Vec<MappingTarget>) =
428:                         dupl.into_iter().cloned().unzip();
429:                     dupl_targets.push(mappings[i].1)
430:                 },
431:             )
432:         }
433:     }

// Regression test for issue #2520 and PR #2650
// Syntax highlighting should be the same regardless of
// --map-syntax' case or file extension's case
#[test]
fn highlighting_independant_from_map_syntax_case() {
    let expected = bat()
        .arg("-f")
        .arg("--map-syntax=*.config:JSON")
        .arg("map-syntax_case.Config")
        .assert()
        .get_output()
        .stdout
        .clone();

    bat()
        .arg("-f")
        .arg("--map-syntax=*.Config:JSON")
        .arg("map-syntax_case.Config")
        .assert()
        .success()
        .stdout(expected)
        .stderr("");
}
